title: Understanding Bias in Models
text: When you add a new feature to a model, especially one that is a transformation of an existing feature, think about how it might help the model capture more complex patterns in the data. How does this affect the model's ability to fit the data?

title: Effect of Adding Features
text: Consider how adding a feature that is a transformation of an existing feature might affect the model's flexibility. Does this make the model more or less likely to fit the training data closely?

title: Possible Effects on (Model Bias)**2
text: What happens to the bias of a model when it becomes more flexible and can fit the data more closely?
